story.summaryEn:
Home ground for Gabi, FP1 completed.
Freddie’s car suffered an issue and stopped on track. We will investigate the problem fully as soon as the car is back in the garage.
detailZh:
加比的家乡赛道，自由练习一结束。
弗雷迪的赛车出现了问题，停在赛道上。我们将尽快在赛车回到维修区后全面调查这个问题。
detailEn:
Home ground for Gabi, FP1 completed.
Freddie’s car suffered an issue and stopped on track. We will investigate the problem fully as soon as the car is back in the garage.
